usage: The word 嫲嫲 (maa4 maa4) refers specifically to your father's mother, which is the paternal grandmother in English.
You can use 嫲嫲 as a direct subject in a sentence, for example, 嫲嫲啱啱煲咗湯 (Paternal grandma just made soup).
It is usually used in a familiar or affectionate context when talking about your family.
嫲嫲 is often used to show respect and affection towards the older generation on your father's side.
